title: Hikaru Genji Chrysanthemum Doll Kiku Ningyo Display, Japan Vintage Photo
description: A black-and-white photograph capturing an elaborate Japanese kiku ningyo (chrysanthemum doll) display depicting Hikaru Genji, the protagonist of Murasaki Shikibu's classic Heian-era novel 'The Tale of Genji'. A small identification plaque reading '光源氏' (Hikaru Genji) rests on the floor beside the figure. The doll is dressed in traditional courtier garments crafted entirely from intricately arranged chrysanthemum blossoms, paired with Heian-style court headgear and a folding fan. The figure is staged on a traditional wooden veranda (engawa) in front of painted screens depicting pine trees, typical of autumn chrysanthemum festival exhibitions in mid-20th-century Japan.
